role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 干扰者尤其擅长搅乱敌人的计划。他可以召唤无法逾越的围栏困住目标，降下一阵使人沉默的风暴，如果敌人发动突袭，他还可以直接将对手往回传送。
hero_summary_en: Disruptor excels at shattering the plans of his enemies. Summoning impassable fences to trap targets as he calls down a silencing storm, should a foe attempt something unexpected he simply teleports them back to their earlier location.

abilities.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
abilities.description_zh: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
abilities.description_en: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.

shard_loc.en: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
shard_loc.zh: 提升风雷之击的施法距离和打击次数。还可以对地施放，使风雷之击先潜伏最多%shard_ground_delay%秒，并附着到第一个进入作用范围的敌人身上。

facet_text_en: Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 风雷之击还会额外打击动能力场内所有敌人。风雷之击的减速时间提升至%slow_duration%秒。

abilities.name: disruptor_glimpse
abilities.description_zh: 将目标英雄传送回他%backtrack_time%秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
abilities.description_en: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes_zh: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。
notes_en: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
abilities.description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes_zh: 力场不能困住减益免疫单位。
notes_en: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.

shard_loc.en: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.
shard_loc.zh: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
abilities.description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
abilities.description_zh: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes_en: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

abilities.name: disruptor_static_storm
abilities.description_zh: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
abilities.description_en: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_disruptor_consecutive_strike_damage
talents_raw.desc_loc: Every strike increases the damage of subsequent strikes until the debuff expires
